heading: Saturday, April 5, 2025
topLine: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick.

items.headline: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick
items.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Scout (17B active / 109B total parameters, 16 experts, 10M-token context) and Llama 4 Maverick (17B active / 400B total, 128 experts), its first natively multimodal mixture-of-experts models, as open-weight downloads on llama.com and Hugging Face. Meta previewed the larger Llama 4 Behemoth, still in training, and claims Maverick beats GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash on a range of benchmarks.
